title: Romance scam: an online sweetheart needs money for customs

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: Hello my love, it's David. I miss you so much, I can't wait to finally meet you in person.

lines.speaker: senior
lines.text: Oh David, I've been counting the days!

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: My darling, there's a problem. I'm stuck at the airport in Dubai and customs is holding my bags. I need $3,500 to get them released.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: I'll pay you back the second I land, I promise. You can send it with Bitcoin, I'll show you how.

lines.speaker: caller
lines.text: And please don't tell your kids about us yet. They wouldn't understand our love.
